column1: # Production's coverage windows for src/ng/window_coverage/production_parity.rs, frozen at promotion
# plan step C13, one row per generated stream. Each is what production's
# sample_summary::coverage::SlidingWindowCoverageAccumulator emitted at commit d9e7b076 on the stream
# that seed generates: every window in emission order, reduced to its count and an FNV-1a digest over
# each window's contig (u32), centre (u32), mean depth and GC fraction (each f32 as its bit pattern),
# all little-endian. The full stream is 447,581 windows, too large to commit window by window.
# Columns, tab-separated: seed, window width in bases, windows emitted, digest.
